# XRP Swap

> XRP Swap is a non-custodial interface for swapping XRP to and from BTC, ETH, USDT and other assets. It offers on-ledger swaps through the XRP Ledger's decentralized exchange and cross-chain instant-exchange routes. The interface never holds keys or funds.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- On-ledger route uses the XRP Ledger DEX, including order books, path payments and AMM pools, signed from your own XRPL wallet.
- Issued tokens such as stablecoins on the XRPL require a trust line to the issuer before you can receive them.
- Cross-chain routes cover BTC and ETH: send to a deposit address and receive at your own wallet on the destination network.
- An XRPL account needs a base XRP reserve to exist, with an additional owner reserve for each trust line or offer; amounts are set by the network.
- Many exchanges require a destination tag on XRP deposits, and XRPL transaction fees are a tiny amount of XRP.
